text:
Predicates:
Winner(x, y) ::: x was the winner of y.
Participated(x, y) ::: x participated in y.
TieOnLeaderboard(y) ::: y is a tie on the leaderboard.
FromBelgium(x) ::: x is from Belgium.
OnLeaderboard(x, y) ::: x is on the leaderboard of y.
Premises:
Winner(Steinhauer, duMaurier1992) ::: The winner of the 1992 du Maurier Classic was Steinhauer.
Participated(Steinhauer, duMaurier1992) ::: Steinhauer participated in the 1992 du Maurier Classic.
∃x (TieOnLeaderboard(x) ∧ ∃y (FromBelgium(y) ∧ OnLeaderboard(y, duMaurier1992))) ::: There was a six-way tie and one person from Belgium was in the tie.
Descampe(Descampe) ∧ FromBelgium(Descampe) ∧ OnLeaderboard(Descampe, duMaurier1992) ::: Descampé is from Belgium and is on the leaderboard.
∀x (OnLeaderboard(x, duMaurier1992) → Participated(x, duMaurier1992)) ::: All people on the leaderboard participated in the 1992 du Maurier Classic.
Conclusion:
¬Winner(Steinhauer, duMaurier1992) ::: Steinhauer was not the winner of the 1992 du Maurier Classic.
